navaid.name: Hastings Front Range Light
navaid.description: The front range light that works in conjunction with Hastings Lighthouse on West Hill to guide the fishing fleet in.

navaid.name: Norman's Bay Wreck
navaid.description: The wreck has yet to be identified but it is known to be a large warship of the period 1600-1800. The site consists of a cluster of at least 42 iron guns, timber hull structure and other artefacts.

navaid.name: SS Barnhill
navaid.description: Boilers visible from shore at low tide
Possibly a brig from Nova Scotia named the Avon. Increasingly visible since 2016.

navaid.name: Amsterdam
navaid.description: Cargo ship built in 1748, wrecked in a storm on the English Channel. There have been discussions about recovering and relocating the wreck to Amsterdam for preservation and display.
